heading: Real Results Delivered for our Community.
text: When Tampa Bay families needed results, Gus delivered, from disaster recovery to lower costs. See how he is delivering for us all over Pasco and Hillsborough.

heading: Deep roots. Real Results. Proven Conservative.
text: Gus Bilirakis is a husband, father, attorney, and son with deep roots to this community. He grew up in the Tampa Bay area, watched his father Mike serve this same community in Congress, and has served the people of this region by quietly building one of the most effective records in the U.S. House.

heading: Deep roots. Real Results. Proven Conservative.
text: As a senior member of the Energy & Commerce Committee and a veteran legislator with deep relationships across the aisle, Gus has built a record measured by bills passed and dollars delivered, not cable-TV hits.

heading: Planning to vote by mail?
text: In Florida, Vote-by-Mail requests don't carry over from year to year, so each general election cycle you simply submit a new one. If you want to Vote By Mail for Gus Bilirakis, request your ballot today!

heading: Stand with Gus.

heading: Issues & Record.
text: Learn how Gus is leading and delivering on the critical issues facing our community.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Groceries, housing, and the everyday basics cost more every week. Families are squeezed by inflation on every necessity, workers watch tips and overtime get taxed away, and seniors stretch fixed incomes thinner every month.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Gus delivered the new $6,000 senior tax exemption , championed no tax on tips and no tax on overtime , and continues to push affordability legislation that puts money back in working families' pockets, including ending taxation on Social Security, lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and his new homeowners insurance deduction.

heading: Homeowners & Flood Insurance Affordability
text: Floridians are losing the dream of homeownership to skyrocketing insurance premiums. Seniors on fixed incomes are being priced out of houses they've owned for decades.

heading: Homeowners & Flood Insurance Affordability
text: Gus filed the Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act , an above-the-line $10,000 tax deduction on homeowners insurance premiums for a primary residence, and is fighting for an Anclote River Basin study to attack the flooding driving repetitive-loss premiums in the first place.

heading: One of Congress's Most Effective Members
text: Talk is cheap in Washington. What matters is who actually passes legislation and delivers real results for the families and Seniors they represent.

heading: One of Congress's Most Effective Members
text: The nonpartisan Center for Effective Lawmaking has named Gus one of the most effective members of Congress, multiple times , a ranking measured by bills passed and results delivered, not headlines. It is independent proof of what Pasco and Hillsborough already know: Gus shows up and gets things done.

heading: Hurricane Recovery in West Pasco
text: Helene and Milton flattened parts of Hudson, Holiday, Port Richey, and New Port Richey. Recovery has been slow, repetitive losses are mounting, and families are tired of waiting.

heading: Hurricane Recovery in West Pasco
text: Gus secured $585 million in federal disaster-recovery funding for Pasco County, usable for direct hurricane relief and for the long-term infrastructure work needed to fortify the county against the next storm.

heading: Mental Health & Addiction
text: Every family in Pasco and Hillsborough has been touched by addiction or mental illness. The system has gaps that swallow the people who need help most.

heading: Mental Health & Addiction
text: Gus secured $2 million to expand mental-health services at FQHCs, brought federal funding to open Vincent House Pasco for those battling mental illness, secured funding for a one-stop behavioral-health hub in Pasco, extended telehealth for seniors through the EASE Act , and expanded the types of licensed therapists who can participate in Medicare.

heading: Children's Health & Rare Disease
text: Kids with rare diseases lose precious time when conditions go undiagnosed at birth, and pediatric cancer drug development still lags pediatric need.

heading: Children's Health & Rare Disease
text: Gus is leading the fight to expand the federal newborn-screening panel (two new conditions were added at HHS this year) and he secured the reauthorization of the Pediatric Cancer Voucher to fast-track new treatments for sick kids. He also delivered the longest reauthorization of KidCare in the program's history.

heading: Public Safety, School Safety, & the Border
text: Cartels are pushing fentanyl into our neighborhoods, predators are using AI to victimize children, and parents are still worried about safety in the schoolhouse.

heading: Public Safety, School Safety, & the Border
text: Gus secured the wall to choke off the cartels driving human and drug trafficking, passed the Take It Down Act to give law enforcement new tools against AI-generated child sexual abuse material, and brought $3 million in school-safety funding to districts in the new CD 12 footprint this year. Pasco Sheriff Chris Nocco speaks to this record.

heading: Supporting the Trump Agenda
text: Florida families want a Washington that secures the border, lowers costs, and puts America First. That takes a representative who will stand with President Trump and fight to get his agenda across the finish line.

heading: Supporting the Trump Agenda
text: Gus is a proven partner for the America First agenda, voting to secure the border, cut taxes for working families and seniors, and unleash American energy, the record that earned him President Trump's full support.

heading: Privacy Policy.
text: How Bilirakis For Congress collects, uses, and protects your information.

heading: Introduction
text: Bilirakis For Congress respects your privacy and is committed to protecting it through our compliance policy. This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you visit the website, provide through online signups or in-person events, and/or subscribe to our mobile text services (collectively, the “Platform”) and our practices for collecting, using and maintaining, protecting and disclosing that information.

heading: Introduction
text: The policy applies to the information we collect:

heading: Introduction
text: In email(s), SMS/MMS text(s), and other electronic messages between you and Bilirakis For Congress;

heading: Introduction
text: When you provide it to Bilirakis For Congress through an online signup process or at an in-person event;

heading: Introduction
text: When you contribute to Bilirakis For Congress or purchase merchandise.

heading: Introduction
text: It does not apply to information collected by any third party, including through any application or content (including advertising) that may link to or be accessible from the Platform.

heading: Introduction
text: Please read this policy carefully to understand our policies and practices regarding your information and how we will treat it. If you disagree with our policies and practices, your choice is not to use the Platform. By accessing or using the Platform or signing up for services offered by Bilirakis For Congress, or continuing to use services offered by Bilirakis For Congress, you agree to this privacy policy. This policy may change from time to time. Your continued use of the Platform after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: We may collect several types of information from and about the users of the Platform, including:

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: Information by which you may be personally identified, such as name, postal address, e-mail address, telephone number, and financial information you provide when making a contribution (“personal information”).

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: Information that is about you, but individually does not identify you, such as political affiliation, employment information (occupation and employer), demographic information, telephone carrier, and the date, time and content of your message, as well as other information that you provide.

heading: Information We Collect and How
text: All website users remain anonymous unless they choose to give us their personal information.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Directly from you when you provide it to us.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Automatically, as you navigate the site.

heading: We Collect This Information:
text: Automatically when you respond to e-mails or text messages.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: The information we collect on the Platform may include:

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information that you provide by filling in forms on the Platform.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information that you provide to comply with required campaign finance requirements at the federal, state, or local level, such as Name, Address, Occupation, and Employer.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Record and copies of your correspondence if you contact us.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Your responses to surveys, questionnaires, polls, or other data entry that we might ask you to complete.

heading: Information You May Provide to Us
text: Information you have provided to be published on the Platform. Your user contributions are posted on and transmitted to others at your own risk.

heading: Information We May Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies
text: Information about your equipment and devices and internet connection, including your IP address, operating system and browser type.

heading: Information We May Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies
text: We also may use these technologies to collect information about your online activities over time and across third-party websites or other online services (behavioral tracking). Technologies we may use for this automatic data collection may include:

heading: Disclosure of Your Information
text: We may disclose aggregated information about our users and information that does not identify any individual without restriction.

heading: Disclosure of Your Information
text: No personal information, including the phone number, is shared with third parties. Personal information collected should never be shared or sold.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: E-mail: We appreciate your questions and comments about our Site and services and welcome your e-mails and questions submitted to our Site. We will share your messages with those within our organization who are most capable of addressing the issues contained in your message. We may archive your message for a certain period or discard it, but your e-mail address and message will only be used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Submitting your e-mail: Submitting your address anywhere on the site may result in your e-mail address being added to the Bilirakis For Congress e-mail list. You may unsubscribe to Bilirakis For Congress e-mails at any time by opting out of e-mail subscriptions with the “unsubscribe” link included in each e-mail. Your e-mail address will be removed from our marketing list. Please allow us a reasonable period of time in order to satisfy your request, as some promotions may already be in process.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Text Messages: Bilirakis For Congress will use your mobile phone number to send you text messages. These text messages will include news alerts, event notifications, voting reminders, and other similar updates. If you message us, we will share your messages with those within our organization who are most capable of addressing the issues contained in your message. We may archive your message for a certain period of time or discard it, but your mobile phone number and message will only be used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Submitting your mobile phone number: Submitting your mobile phone number to opt-in to our SMS program constitutes your express consent to receive autodialed messages from Bilirakis For Congress. Text STOP to opt-out. Text HELP for support. For further assistance, please e-mail info@bilirakisforcongress.com . Message frequency may vary. Message and Data Rates may apply. By opting-in, you agree to receive autodialed marketing mobile messages, and you understand that your consent to be contacted in this method is not required to make any purchase from us.

heading: Email & Text Message Signups
text: Opt-in consent applies only to Bilirakis For Congress or its successor entities and will not apply to any third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: You may send us an email at info@bilirakisforcongress.com to request access to, correct, or delete any personal information that you have provided to us. We may not accommodate a request to change information if we believe the change would violate any law or legal requirement or cause the information to be incorrect. Colorado and California residents may have additional personal rights and choices.

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: To learn more about California rights, visit https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa .

heading: Accessing and Correcting Your Information
text: To learn more about Colorado rights, visit https://leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb21-190 .

heading: Changes to Our Policy
text: It is our policy to post any changes we make to our privacy policy on this page with a notice that the privacy policy has been updated on the Bilirakis For Congress home page .
